name: lexvm
description: LexVM: a deterministic, offline-first engine and player for LLM-generatable text adventures.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lexvm/engine && npm run packs && npm run build -w @lexvm/web
scripts.dev: npm run packs && npm run dev -w @lexvm/web
scripts.packs: npm run lexvm -- build packs --out apps/web/public/packs
scripts.prompts: npm run lexvm -- prompt --stage oneshot --out prompts/oneshot.md
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p packages/cli && tsc -p apps/web
